title: Laughing Baby on Gravel, Woodland Campsite - Vintage 1940s B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A charming candid snapshot captures an infant or young toddler sitting on coarse gravel and laughing delightfully toward the sky. The baby wears a light-colored short-sleeved romper with buttons and a rounded collar. In the background, the scene reveals a natural woodland or campsite environment, including a dark canvas tent flap on the left where a person appears partially shadowed. The reverse side exhibits residual black scrapbook mounting paper.
